translation.english_title: With a single word it was ruined

source_tamil_lines: என் வாழ்வெல்லாம் மானில மேலே தேய்பிறை போலே (ஒரு)
english_lines: With a single word it was ruined... even love's joy became a dream. (Oru)
I shall marry you,’—so you said...
Why, my lord, have you forgotten all that you said?
My whole life upon this earth is like the waning moon. (Oru)
notes: The source's remembered marriage promise is rendered as quoted speech without adding any wording beyond the two printed lines.
The verified source prints `மானில`; the English follows the contextual earth/world sense without changing the Tamil witness.
The refrain cue `(ஒரு)` is retained as `(Oru)`.

english_lines: What use is there in life, when deceivers have multiplied everywhere?
notes: The source closes with the compact/fragmentary `மங்கை என் வாழ்வெல்லாம்`; the English preserves that incompleteness rather than supplying a missing conclusion.
